title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression adds a penalty term to the loss function to prevent overfitting. This penalty term is proportional to the square of the magnitude of the coefficients. Can you think about how increasing this penalty might affect the flexibility of the model?

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: When you increase the value of lambda, the penalty on large coefficients becomes stronger. Consider how this might influence the model's ability to fit the training data closely.

title: Model Variance and Lambda
text: As lambda increases, what happens to the model variance?
